summary: Implemented the file-reading progress feature in rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _ReaderContext helpers, module-level open and wrap_file, and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file). Added 19 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, a "Reading from a file" and a "Reading from a file-like object" subsection to docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry linking PR 1759. Changes are additive (764 insertions, no deletions) and uncommitted. Not verified: I did not run tests, mypy, or any repository code, so type-checking and runtime behaviour are unconfirmed. Open risk: on Python 3.6, _FileReader may be abstract because of inherited typing.BinaryIO members (name, mode).
